tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the text models this API key can ask, with their USD prices per million tokens, the reasoning efforts each takes and the call fee.

tools.name: ask_model
tools.description: Send a prompt to one text model of the TopxAI catalogue and return its reply. The models reason before they answer and the reasoning counts toward max_output_tokens, so leave at least 4096 tokens for a full answer or pass a lower reasoning_effort.
